note: NECO Government round 7 (R38 top-up): NNDP 1923; Awolowo's UPN; INEC's federal elections; FEDECO 1979; judicial review; the Waziri; the Ogboni check on the Oyo Mesi; the Igbo age-grade; gerrymandering; Aguiyi-Ironsi the first military Head of State; Nzeogwu's January 1966 coup; the July 1966 counter-coup; the Mid-West Region of 1963 by referendum; the Code of Conduct Bureau; the ICPC; the register of voters; the returning officer; the election petition tribunal; a hung parliament; the Speaker; the constituency; the constitution as supreme law; the electorate; party symbols for illiterate voters; the mace. Scanned against the whole Government pool (WAEC, NECO and JAMB stems).
